_protocol_note: Seeds, generation parameters and the low-confidence threshold are read from protocol_source at run time so E1-v2 cannot drift from v1 E1. logprobs top_k comes from configs/config.yaml llm.logprobs.top_k, exactly as v1 E1 did.

prompts._note: System prompt per dataset; {org} and {domain} are filled from the item. 'default' is used for any dataset without its own entry.

d1_open.system: You are a helpful voice assistant. Answer the user's question briefly.

d2_support.system: You are a customer support voice agent for {org}, a {domain} company. Answer the caller briefly.

v1_e1.system: You are a customer support voice agent for {org}, a {domain} company. Answer the caller briefly.

default.system: You are a helpful voice assistant. Answer the user's question briefly.

prompts.grounded_system_suffix: Use the reference passages below when they are relevant.

history._note: History turns become chat turns. Consecutive same-role turns are merged and a leading assistant turn is folded into the system prompt, because Mistral's chat template rejects anything but strict user/assistant alternation starting with user.
history.leading_assistant_template: Earlier in this call you said: "{text}"
